# hubspot_account_membership (Resource)

Manages one HubSpot account membership by its canonical Settings user `id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hubspot_account_membership" "operator" {
  email              = "operator@example.com"
  first_name         = "Release"
  last_name          = "Operator"
  send_welcome_email = false
  allow_removal      = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Global HubSpot identity email. Changes replace the account membership.
- `send_welcome_email` (Boolean) Creation-only choice to ask HubSpot to send its welcome email. Changes replace the membership.

### Optional

- `allow_removal` (Boolean) Local opt-in guard for account membership removal. Defaults to `false`.
- `first_name` (String) Observed or configured global first name. Configured changes require an activated user and can affect the identity across accounts.
- `last_name` (String) Observed or configured global last name. Configured changes require an activated user and can affect the identity across accounts.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Canonical HubSpot Settings user `id` used for state and import.
- `super_admin` (Boolean) Whether HubSpot currently reports this member as a Super Admin.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import hubspot_account_membership.operator 'email:operator@example.com'
```
